# token-maxxing

> token-maxxing is a free, open source (MIT) Claude Code mod that shows Claude Code token usage per model, this month and all time, the API-equivalent cost of that usage at Anthropic's public prices (what it would cost with your own API key, BYOK), and the return on a Claude subscription ("ROI": API-equivalent cost divided by what the user paid).

It answers questions like "how many tokens do I use in Claude Code?", "how much would my Claude Code usage cost on the API?" and "is my Claude subscription worth it?".

## Install

- In Claude Code, in a terminal: `/plugin install token-maxxing --marketplace JCK-Sabords/token-maxxing`, then type `/tokens`.
- In the Claude desktop app: + next to the prompt, Plugins, Add marketplace `JCK-Sabords/token-maxxing`, then Add plugin.
- Requires Claude Code v2.1.287 or later (v2.1.286 in the desktop app). Works in the CLI, the desktop app's Code tab and the VS Code extension.
- To see the ROI, set the plan price per month: `/plugin configure token-maxxing@token-maxxing` (option `planPriceUsd`). Option `language`: `en` or `fr`.

## How it computes

- Source: Claude Code's local transcripts (`~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl`). Cloud sessions and claude.ai chats are not counted.
- Each reply is counted once, with its final output token count.
- Prices: Anthropic's public API rates (November 2026), cache writes at 1.25x input (5 minutes) or 2x (1 hour), cache reads at each model's rate, fast mode at 2x.
- 100% local: it reads the transcripts, writes a small cache (~/.claude/token-maxxing/cache.json) that keeps the all-time total, may run printenv to find the home folder, and makes no network calls.

## Flex

The flex page turns the score into a profile picture frame ("Claude ROI-maxxer ~ x11.3"), drawn in the browser. Free with a small signature, 0.99 EUR in HD without it.
